maya: quick idea  run a 3-week micro-refapp sprint: 3 short tutorials, one tiny refapp, and a live mentor drop-in. deliverables: launch post, tutorial cadence, refapp repo, webinar funnel, inbound routing.

devon: +1. i'll fork the starter and add a Docker quickstart. ETA Tue morning.

li: i'll draft the 3 tutorials (15-20m each). include reproducible prompts, a 2-line benchmark blurb, and "next steps". drafts by Fri.

sophia: i'll own the landing page & email drip (confirm, 24h reminder, follow-up with repo + replay). will add UTMs + HubSpot tags.

maya: routing idea: tag leads `microrefapp_sprint`; if they click "talk to eng" or complete >60% labs, route to solutions-eng. set nurtures in HubSpot.

devon: metrics to track: landing views, signups, attendance rate, lab completions, repo stars, MQLs. add dashboards to Amplitude + HubSpot.

li: content structure i'll push:
```
/tutorials/micro-refapp/lab-1-setup.md
/tutorials/micro-refapp/lab-2-batching.md
/tutorials/micro-refapp/lab-3-deploy.md
/refapps/micro-refapp/README.md
/benchmarks/microrefapp-demo-blurb.md
```

sophia: landing copy draft: "Build a tiny refapp with Redwood Inference in 40 minutes. Join our Micro RefApp Sprint." doc: https://docs.google.com/microrefapp-landing  comments welcome.

maya: marketing-bot, create review task for launch post next Wed.

marketing-bot: task created /tasks/6123 assigned to @maya @sophia @li  review due Wed 09:00 PT.

devon: license: MIT and add CONTRIBUTING.md for mentors. i'll tag v0.1 when pushed.

maya: timeline recap: repo Tue, tutorials Fri, review Wed, publish Thu, webinar 2w after publish. sync Tue 10:00 PT. TL;DR: ship refapp + tutorials this week, landing & emails by Fri, publish next Thu. :rocket:
